name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the plugin in the Homebridge log. The Homebridge UI uses it to show the log of this plugin (Plugins → ⋮ → Plugin Logs).

deviceDiscovery.title: Device Discovery
deviceDiscovery.description: Searches the network for Denon / Marantz devices. About 30 seconds after the start, the Homebridge log shows an overview of all found and configured devices (log level at least 'info', or enable the console log below). Needed for adding devices automatically. Manually configured devices under 'Devices' work without it.

autoAddDiscoveredDevices.title: Add Discovered Devices Automatically
autoAddDiscoveredDevices.description: Automatically adds every Denon / Marantz device found in the network as accessory, using its name from the HEOS app and the best control protocol (Hybrid if supported). Devices listed under 'Devices' below keep their manual configuration. Each accessory still has to be added in the Home app once.

excludedSerialNumbers.title: Excluded Devices
excludedSerialNumbers.description: Serial numbers of discovered devices that should not be added automatically.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Devices you add here are set up with exactly these settings. Devices that are added automatically don't need an entry; add one only to change their settings (same serial number). Name, serial number, IP address and control protocol are required; an entry without name, serial number and IP address is ignored (the settings form starts with such an empty entry).

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Printed on the type label of the device. Or turn on Device Discovery once: the log lists the serial number of every device found.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Please assign a static IP address to your device and enter it here.

controlProtocol.title: Control Protocol
controlProtocol.description: HEOS CLI: speakers like the Denon Home series (on/off = play/stop). Hybrid: devices that also support AVR Control, e.g. AV receivers and the Denon Home Amp (real standby). AVR Control: receivers without HEOS. The device overview in the log shows the recommended protocol of each discovered device; an unsupported protocol is replaced automatically at startup (with a warning).

volumeLimitEnabled.title: Volume Limit
volumeLimitEnabled.description: When you set a volume limit, 100% volume in the Home app will correspond to this percentage on your device.

volumeLimit.description: Only has an effect if the volume limit is enabled above.
volumeLimit.title: Volume Limit (%)

volumeStepSize.title: Volume Step Size
volumeStepSize.description: How many percentage points the volume buttons of the Remote change the volume. Measured on the device, not converted by the volume limit.

powerOnFavorite.title: Power On Favorite
powerOnFavorite.description: HEOS CLI and Hybrid: if the device has nothing to resume when it is switched on, this HEOS favorite is started (1 = first favorite in the HEOS app, up to 200). 0 = disabled. At startup the plugin warns if the favorite doesn't exist. Not used while a Power On Quick Select slot is set (Quick Select takes precedence).

powerOnQuickSelect.title: Power On Quick Select
powerOnQuickSelect.description: HEOS CLI and Hybrid: start this Quick Select slot of the device instead of the HEOS favorite when the device has nothing to resume (1–6, depending on the model, e.g. Denon Home 150: 1–3, Denon Home 300: 1–6). 0 = use the HEOS favorite. At startup the plugin warns if the slot doesn't exist. Takes precedence over the Power On Favorite: while a slot is set, the favorite isn't used.

debug.title: Debug Log
debug.description: Writes all commands and answers of this device (HEOS and AVR Control) and what it reports at startup (protocols, inputs, favorites, Quick Select slots) to the normal log. The Debug Mode of Homebridge or the child bridge isn't needed. Only for troubleshooting: switch it off again afterwards.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The list of inputs to your device. If you configure inputs here, those inputs will become selectable in the Home app.

showInList.title: Show in Input List
showInList.description: If disabled, this input will not be shown in the list of selectable inputs in the Home app.

consoleLogEnabled.title: Console Log
consoleLogEnabled.description: Diverts the log messages directly to the console. This is only intended for debugging purposes.

consoleLogLevel.title: Log Level
consoleLogLevel.description: If console log is enabled, only log messages at this log level or below it will be displayed in the console.

layout.title: Devices (manual setup)
layout.description: Optional. Add a device here to set it up manually or to change the settings of an automatically added device.

layout.title: Troubleshooting
layout.description: Only needed when looking for errors.
